scripts.test:firebase:
npm --prefix ../../firebase/functions run build && printf 'SUPABASE_SERVICE_ROLE_KEY=test-key
STRIPE_SECRET_KEY=sk_test_dummy_emulator_only
STRIPE_WEBHOOK_SECRET=whsec_dummy_emulator_only
' > ../../firebase/functions/.secret.local && printf 'LEGACY_BRIDGE=supabase
SUPABASE_URL=http://127.0.0.1:54321
APPCHECK_ENFORCE_VOTE=false
APPCHECK_ENFORCE_DEDICATION=false
APPCHECK_ENFORCE_REQUEST=false
APPCHECK_ENFORCE_OWNER=false
APPCHECK_ENFORCE_PUBLIC_EVENT=false
APPCHECK_ENFORCE_PHOTO=false
APPCHECK_ENFORCE_BILLING=false
' > ../../firebase/functions/.env.demo-iomixo && SUPABASE_SERVICE_ROLE_KEY=test-key NEXT_PUBLIC_FIREBASE_USE_EMULATORS=true firebase emulators:exec --config ../../firebase/firebase.json --project demo-iomixo --only auth,firestore,functions,storage "tsx --test --test-timeout=60000 --test-concurrency=1 tests/firebase/*.test.ts"
